# Resolved start lines of the stable launchers at DD-0 HEAD (origin/main 3f8b0c8), recorded by DD-14a and kept
# byte for byte by DD-22 as templates over the local config: <KEY_WIN> is the Windows form of KEY of
# drivedit.local.env (tools/local_config.py render). Rendered with this machine's config they must equal the
# start lines the launchers produce there (tests: the placeholder config; tools/migrate_local_config.py: a real one).
# <launcher>\t<start line with every set variable expanded; the launch id is <LID>>
wb_R1.bat	start "" /D "<TOOLS_INSTALL_WIN>\Workbench" "<TOOLS_INSTALL_WIN>\Workbench\ArmaReforgerWorkbenchSteamDiag.exe" -profile "<DATA_ROOT_WIN>\wb_profile" -gproj "<DATA_ROOT_WIN>\addons\DataCapture\addon.gproj" -addonsDir "<GAME_INSTALL_WIN>\addons" -forceUpdate -maxFPS 60 -dcLaunchId <LID>
client_R1_i01.bat	start "" /D "<GAME_INSTALL_WIN>" "<GAME_INSTALL_WIN>\ArmaReforgerSteam.exe" -profile "<DATA_ROOT_WIN>\client_profiles\i01" -logsDir "<DATA_ROOT_WIN>\logs\i01" -cfg "<DATA_ROOT_WIN>\tools\cfg\engine_R1.conf" -window -screenWidth 1408 -screenHeight 720 -posX 0 -posY 0 -forceUpdate -noFocus -maxFPS 60 -GPUAdapter 0 -freezeCheck 120 -freezeCheckMode kill -noThrow -dcLaunchId <LID> -addonsDir "<DATA_ROOT_WIN>\addons" -addons 88BEF4187E0D2DFC -world "UNSET"
